def.en: A strong liking for someone that makes them feel extra special; common while growing up and usually temporary.
def.hg: Kisi ko itna pasand karna ki woh sabse special lagne lage; bade hote time yeh common hai aur usually temporary hota hai.

def.en: A feeling of being drawn to another person; it is something that happens, not a decision or an action.
def.hg: Kisi doosre insaan ki taraf khinchaav ki feeling; yeh apne aap hoti hai, yeh na koi decision hai aur na koi action.

def.en: The penis becoming larger and firmer when extra blood fills its spongy tissue; it often happens without any control.
def.hg: Penis ka bada aur firm ho jaana, jab uske spongy tissue mein extra blood bhar jaata hai; yeh aksar bina control ke hota hai.

def.en: The release of semen during sleep, common in puberty. It is normal, cannot be controlled and is not a fault.
def.hg: Neend mein semen ka nikalna, jo puberty mein common hai. Yeh normal hai, control nahi hota, aur isme koi dosh nahi.

def.en: The whitish fluid released from the penis that carries sperm; the body makes it continuously from puberty onwards.
def.hg: Penis se nikalne wala safed sa fluid jisme sperm hote hain; puberty ke baad se body ise lagataar banati rehti hai.

def.en: The right to keep your body, body changes and personal feelings away from other people's eyes, comments and questions.
def.hg: Apni body, body changes aur personal feelings ko doosron ki nazron, comments aur sawaalon se door rakhne ka haq.

def.en: The pattern of who a person is romantically or sexually attracted to over time, such as heterosexual, gay, lesbian or bisexual.
def.hg: Lambe time mein koi insaan romantically ya sexually kiski taraf attract hota hai, iska pattern; jaise heterosexual, gay, lesbian ya bisexual.

def.en: Describes a person who feels little or no sexual attraction to anyone; a normal variation, not an illness.
def.hg: Aisa insaan jise kisi ke liye bhi sexual attraction bahut kam ya bilkul nahi hota; yeh normal variation hai, bimari nahi.

def.en: The body's response to sexual feelings, such as a faster heartbeat and more blood flow to the genitals; it can happen without intending it.
def.hg: Sexual feelings pe body ka response, jaise tez heartbeat aur genitals mein blood flow badhna; yeh bina chahe bhi ho sakta hai.

def.en: Touching one's own genitals for a pleasant sexual feeling; common, private and not physically harmful, and not doing it is equally normal.
def.hg: Pleasant sexual feeling ke liye apne hi genitals ko touch karna; yeh common hai, private hai aur body ke liye harmful nahi, aur ise na karna bhi utna hi normal hai.

def.en: The release of semen from the penis; it can also occur during sleep, when it is called a wet dream.
def.hg: Penis se semen ka nikalna; yeh neend mein bhi ho sakta hai, jise wet dream kehte hain.

def.en: A recognised culture-linked worry, common in South Asia, that losing semen drains strength; the worry is treatable by talking to a doctor.
def.hg: South Asia mein common, culture se judi ek recognised tension ki semen nikalne se taakat kam hoti hai; doctor se baat karne par is tension ka treatment ho sakta hai.
